g.title: MACHINE_MAINS
g.text: Permanent mains, downstream of the main switch but upstream of Gicar FA7. Must not come off a switched contact.

g.title: BOARD_HV_PRO
g.text: DANGER HV. Pro Rev 1.1. P is the dimmed triac output. V unused here. Differs from BOARD_HV on the Standard board.

g.title: PUMP
g.text: Lelit 4000040, 120 V. N is the thermal-fuse leg - leave it alone.

g.title: TRANSDUCER
g.text: Tap at the high-pressure brass cross joint 9700001, 1/8 BSP, beside the OPV. Not the barbed 4-way cross 2200110, which is low pressure.

g.title: PRESSURE_PORT
g.text: Feeds the onboard ADS1115. X unused.
